Feature 12 in MAT25-K-2270-1942 is exactly NEW-2259-1961. All original R338 panels and keys are preserved. The completed R332-B-0098-0092 association is maker-confirmed and unchanged. Historical R338 review.

A simpler conservative method

Use one common neighbor-clipped aperture, exclude its brightest 20% by maximum RGB channel, and compare the remaining mean brightness with nearby black and colored references. A new correction must stay black under the predeclared smaller/larger apertures. Edge-near bodies and uncertain results keep their labels. No morphology, highlight-hue test, reflection tracking, annulus or pattern color is used.

A weighted-luminance trial was rejected because it mislabeled a visibly red body. Maximum-channel brightness removes that failure without extra per-bead rules. Both methods still abstain on many maker-confirmed black bodies. Control agreements are exposed retrospective checks, not new blind accuracy.
